name: Coldplay

whyMatters.en: Post-Britpop London four that turned delay-soaked guitar and piano hooks into global stadium alternative—Parachutes (2000) and A Rush of Blood to the Head (2002) defined early-2000s mass radio beside Radiohead’s art-rock fork.
whyMatters.zh: 后 Britpop 伦敦四人组：把延时吉他与钢琴钩子变成全球体育场 alternative——Parachutes（2000）与 A Rush of Blood to the Head（2002）定义 2000 年代初大众电台，与 Radiohead art-rock 分叉并列。

lyricQuotes: Look at the stars / Look how they shine for you
Lights will guide you home / And ignite your bones

shortBio.en: Chris Martin four-piece; Yellow and Clocks made piano/delay alternative a mass format, Viva la Vida the Eno maximal pivot.
shortBio.zh: Chris Martin 四人组；Yellow 与 Clocks 把钢琴/延时 alternative 做成大众格式，Viva la Vida 是 Eno 最大化转向。

body.en:
Formed 1996 at UCL, London. Parachutes (2000, Ken Nelson) established Buckland’s delay-soaked arpeggios, Martin’s falsetto, and mid-tempo emotional frames—Yellow as debut marker. A Rush of Blood to the Head (2002) added Clocks’s piano ostinato and The Scientist ballad dynamics.

Later records (Brian Eno on Viva la Vida, Mylo Xyloto) lean chart maximalism; early catalog is the rock-chronicle hinge from Britpop hangover to 2000s stadium alternative.
body.zh:
1996 年于伦敦 UCL 组建。Parachutes（2000，Ken Nelson）确立 Buckland 延时琶音、Martin 假声与中速情绪框架——Yellow 为出道标记。A Rush of Blood to the Head（2002）加入 Clocks 钢琴 ostinato 与 The Scientist 抒情动态。

后期（Viva la Vida、Mylo Xyloto 的 Brian Eno）偏榜单最大化；早期目录是编年史里从 Britpop 余波接到 2000 年代体育场 alternative 的铰链。

note.en: Parachutes debut single; Buckland delay swells, Martin falsetto lift.
note.zh: Parachutes 出道单曲；Buckland 延时铺展、Martin 假声抬升。

note.en: Piano ostinato hook; A Rush of Blood US breakthrough.
note.zh: 钢琴 ostinato 钩子；A Rush of Blood 美国突破。

note.en: Ballad pivot; reverse-playback video, piano-led dynamic drop.
note.zh: 抒情转向；倒放 MV、钢琴主导动态回落。

title.zh: 钢琴/延时 alternative 作为大众电台

body.en:
Yellow and Clocks prove the early template: Buckland’s dotted-delay guitar, Martin falsetto, Berryman/Champion steady pulse. Emotional lyric at mid-tempo, not shoegaze wash.

A Rush of Blood consolidates the format before Eno-era expansion.
body.zh:
Yellow 与 Clocks 证明早期模板：Buckland 点延时吉他、Martin 假声、Berryman/Champion 稳脉冲。中速情绪歌词，非 shoegaze 铺底。

A Rush of Blood 在 Eno 时期扩张前巩固格式。

body.en:
Martin/Buckland/Berryman founding trio; Champion joins 1997 on drums. No classic lineup fracture—same four names from Parachutes through stadium cycles.

Live expansion adds keyboardists; core writing stays Martin/Buckland.
body.zh:
Martin/Buckland/Berryman 创始三人；Champion 1997 年加入鼓。无经典阵容分裂——Parachutes 到体育场周期仍是四人名。

现场扩张加键盘手；核心写作仍是 Martin/Buckland。

title.zh: 后 Britpop 体育场铰链

body.en:
Coldplay occupy the mass alternative lane Radiohead refused—same Oxford/London generation, opposite scale choice. Blur’s art-school habit meets U2/Eno production on later LPs.

Early catalog cited as template for 2000s piano-led alt bands globally.
body.zh:
Coldplay 占据 Radiohead 拒绝的大众 alternative 车道——同代牛津/伦敦，相反体量选择。Blur 艺术学院习惯在后期 LP 遇 U2/Eno 制作。

早期目录被引为 2000 年代全球钢琴导向 alt 乐队模板。

interviewQuotes.text: We're not cool and we know it. We're just trying to write songs that connect.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Chris Martin

interviewQuotes.text: The piano and the delay guitar are the band's signature, not the wardrobe.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Jonny Buckland

note.en: Stable four; stadium alt-rock built on delay guitar and piano.
note.zh: 稳定四人；延时吉他 + 钢琴撑起体育场 alternative。

note.en: Delay guitar + falsetto as early-2000s UK alt radio face.
note.zh: 延时吉他 + 假声，作为 2000 年代初英国 alt 电台面孔。

note.en: Piano/delay ballad grammar that later arenas copy at scale.
note.zh: 钢琴/延时谣曲语法，后来被体育场规模复制。
